name: Angels and spirits
description: Angels and Spirits in white, black and blue: flyers, lifegain, flicker and protection, with two commanders to lead them.

cards.name: Ostra, Dusk-Winged Arbiter
cards.rule_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever another Angel or Spirit you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 4 or more life this turn, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Ithrenne, the Veil Between
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever another Angel or Spirit you control enters, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
{2}{U}: Exile another target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
cards.flavor_text: She keeps the door between worlds, and opens it for friends.

cards.name: Choirmaster of the Ninth Sky
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Other Angels and Spirits you control get +1/+1.
cards.flavor_text: One voice leads. A thousand wings answer.

cards.name: Moorlight Wisp
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME dies, you gain 2 life.
cards.flavor_text: A small light that lingers where travellers fell.

cards.name: Ashmoor Whisperer
cards.rule_text:
Flying
CARDNAME can't block.
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Tidemist Attendant
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Dawnveil Guardian
cards.rule_text:
Flying, vigilance
When CARDNAME enters, another target creature you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.

cards.name: Duskhymn Mourner
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever another nontoken Angel or Spirit you control dies, you may pay {1}{B}. If you do, return that card to your hand.
cards.flavor_text: No one is truly gone while someone still sings for them.

cards.name: Brightvigil Angel
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you gain 1 life for each creature you control with flying.

cards.name: Tollmarsh Phantom
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever CARDNAME or another Spirit you control enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
cards.flavor_text: When the marsh bell rings, even the bold stand still.

cards.name: Grimvault Seraph
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Highspire Vigilant
cards.rule_text:
Flying, vigilance
When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying for each opponent you have.

cards.name: Dirgewing Paragon
cards.rule_text:
Flying, lifelink
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Angels and Spirits you control.
cards.flavor_text: Its song is the last thing the wicked hear.

cards.name: Veilward Passage
cards.rule_text: Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it's an Angel or Spirit, you gain 3 life.

cards.name: Requiem Verdict
cards.rule_text: Exile target creature. You gain 2 life.
cards.flavor_text: The choir does not judge. It only remembers.

cards.name: Hush of the Restless
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}. If you control an Angel or Spirit, scry 2.

cards.name: Rapture of the Pale Host
cards.rule_text: Exile all creatures. Then return all Angel and Spirit cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owners' control.
cards.flavor_text: The sky takes back only what it can carry.

cards.name: Bell of the Restless Choir
cards.rule_text:
Whenever an Angel or Spirit you control enters, you gain 1 life.
{3}, {T}: Create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Vow of the Undying Wing
cards.rule_text: Whenever a nontoken Angel or Spirit you control dies, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Belfry of Drifting Souls
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an Angel or Spirit spell.
